title: Provision floor reads and tracker commits race across verifier lock boundaries
description: Timing correctness review: `EpochFloorAuthority.current` obtains verifier metadata and later reacquires the verifier lock through `accepts`, so concurrent install can turn a valid snapshot into a transient build-floor UNAUTHENTICATED result. `_adopt_locked` can also validate one floor and commit after another thread raises it. Expose an atomic floor snapshot plus generation or shared transaction; retry or reject if generation changes before commit. Add deterministic interleaving tests proving no successful adoption below an installed floor.
